extended_qualification: The unresolved indices are not hits and not misses: no complete factorization or exponent-one prime was obtained within the stated search windows.
scope_limit: This proves only that u_n is non-squarefull for 2<=n<=1000. It does not imply eventual non-squarefullness or close the Pell route.
verification: Every p is prime by deterministic 64-bit Miller-Rabin or one of two saved local Pocklington certificates; every recurrence is recomputed modulo p^2 and satisfies p | u_n but p^2 does not divide u_n.
